title: Isolate the sine squared term
text: Start by subtracting $$1$$ from both sides of the equation: $$\cos(2x)-1=-2\sin**2(x).$$

title: Divide to solve
text: Divide both sides by $$-2$$. Remember that dividing by a negative flips the signs of the terms in the numerator, yielding $$\frac{1-\cos(2x)}{2}.$$
